ugly.definition: If someone or something is ugly, it's not nice to look at.

ultimately.definition: In the end; when nothing else is left.
ultimately.sentence: We will all help, but it is you who are ultimately responsible.

unable.definition: When sosmeone or something is unable to do something, it cannot be done; it is not able to do it.
unable.sentence: I am unable to climb that mountain because I am too weak.

uncertainty.definition: Uncertainty is a state where there is a lack of certainty.

uncle.definition: Your uncle is the brother of your mother or father.
uncle.sentence: My father has a brother, Joe. Joe is my uncle.

unclear.definition: If something is unclear, then it is not clear or isn't easy to understand.
unclear.sentence: The instructions for how to build the machine were unclear.

undergo.definition: If you undergo something, it happens to you; often it is not nice.
undergo.sentence: She had to undergo surgery because of her broken leg.

underlie.definition: If x underlies y, x causes y; x is the reason for y.

understand.definition: To hear and then fully know what was said, know enough to do it. To know the meaning of something.
understand.sentence: She didn't understand. She thought I meant the meeting was today.

undertake.definition: If you undertake something, you take responsibility for doing it and you start to do it.
undertake.sentence: After a common two years, some students undertake industrial or professional placement in their third year.

unemployment.definition: Unemployment is the state of having no job.
unemployment.sentence: Unemployment is a serious social evil.

unfortunately.definition: You use unfortunately to show that you feel something is not the way you wish it was.

uniform.definition: A uniform is clothing that is very similar and worn by a group of people.
uniform.sentence: School uniform was always worn, which for the boys meant khaki shirts and trousers.

union.definition: A union is when many things are joined together.
union.sentence: The League of Nations was a union between many nations.

unique.definition: If something is unique, it is one of a kind; it is unmatched.
unique.sentence: When the school for the deaf opened, it was unique in Europe.

unit.definition: One of a measure of something; the amount of something that is counted as "one".
unit.sentence: He set up the A/C unit.

unite.definition: If two or more things unite, they come together to form a bigger group.

universal.definition: If something is universal, then it is true for everyone or everything everywhere.
universal.sentence: The laws of physics are universal.

universe.definition: The universe is the whole space we live in and everything it contains: our Milky Way and billions of other galaxies that are not all known are part of our universe.
universe.sentence: According to recent theories, our universe would be bent on itself, being finite but having no frontiers.

university.definition: A university is a school of advanced study that offers both undergraduate and graduate classes.
university.sentence: A doctor studies for many years at a university before going to work in a hospital.

unknown.definition: If something is unknown, nobody knows it.
unknown.sentence: Nothing was written down, and it was a long time ago, so his true date of birth is unknown.

unlike.sentence: They were dressed in an unlike manner.

unlikely.definition: If something is unlikely, then it probably will not happen.
unlikely.sentence: It's unlikely that it will rain today.

unusual.definition: If something is unusual, it is not what you expect. It is not an everyday thing or happening.
unusual.sentence: It was a warm night, unusual for mid Winter.

up.definition: State of being up, often with down.

update.sentence: He gave me an update on the situation in New York.

upper.definition: The upper thing is the one that is in a higher position.
upper.sentence: The upper floors of the building are for offices and the lower floors for housing.

upset.sentence: My late arrival caused the professor considerable upset.

urban.definition: If something is urban, it is related to cities.

urge.definition: An urge is a want to do something.
urge.sentence: After watching the basketball game, he had an urge to play too.

useful.definition: Good for a purpose. If something is useful it can be used for something.
useful.sentence: The girl felt motherly and useful.

user.definition: A user is someone who uses something.

usual.definition: Something that is usual happens often.
usual.sentence: It is usual for me to read the newspaper in the morning.

usually.definition: You use usually to talk about what happens most of the time.
usually.sentence: He usually takes a long time to get ready, but he can be fast too.
